ingredients.name: Leafgill
ingredients.description: A cabbage-finned fish that folds its leaves when startled. Give the line slack when it struggles; its layers turn buttery in a pan.

ingredients.name: Pepperbell
ingredients.description: Rattling orange pods hide a warm, peppery seed. Harvest once a day, then cultivate its seeds in your garden.

ingredients.name: Brothback stock
ingredients.description: This kettle-shelled creature vents steam before charging. Step aside and collect the stock it sheds while cooling.

ingredients.name: Lanternroot
ingredients.description: A luminous tuber sheltered beneath dark trees. The tender root becomes sweet when simmered. It can be grown at home.

ingredients.name: Cloudfruit
ingredients.description: Buoyant fruit floats above the mistwood canopy. Gather gently from its low branches. Botanical gloves let you take a larger harvest. Whisk it into an airy dessert.

ingredients.name: Harbor grain
ingredients.description: The harbor keeps a small free grain allowance. Three portions are restored each morning so a hungry kitchen can always recover.

ingredients.name: Custardpetal
ingredients.description: A flower full of golden custard. Pull gently from its rooted meadow patch.

ingredients.name: Emberbulb
ingredients.description: A warm bulb that grows beside mineral shelves; roasting releases its smoky sweetness.

ingredients.name: Mooncap
ingredients.description: A soft luminous mushroom. Gather from the glade without disturbing its tree roots.

ingredients.name: Pearlsprout
ingredients.description: A crunchy vegetable with pearl-like kernels nestled in pale sea leaves.

ingredients.name: Bubblecarp
ingredients.description: A dumpling-shaped fish with bubbly fins. Use your rod and give slack when it pulls.

ingredients.name: Lavafin
ingredients.description: A toasted fish with a glowing spice sail. It lives in warm water, never in lava.

ingredients.name: Jellyray
ingredients.description: A gelatinous ray with mint-colored wings. Fish from moonwater or reef banks.

ingredients.name: Custardram cream
ingredients.description: Custardrams startle at footsteps. Stand still nearby for two seconds, then collect a dollop of cream while the ram is calm.

ingredients.name: Spiceclaw spice
ingredients.description: A Spicecrab retreats from your approach. Three careful pickaxe contacts crack its spice shell; collect the shed spice without harming the crab.

ingredients.name: Mochimoth pollen
ingredients.description: Mochimoths follow Lanternroot light. Hold a Lanternroot ingredient in your hotbar to lure one close, then gently collect its pollen.

ingredients.name: Kelp jelly
ingredients.description: A Kelpsnail curls up when dry. Water it once with your can, then collect the jelly it sheds. This uses one unit of water.

ingredients.name: Dew nectar
ingredients.description: Water a closed Dewblossom with your can to open its petals, then harvest the dew nectar. One bloom per day.

ingredients.name: Cinnamon sap
ingredients.description: Use your field knife on the Cinnamon sap tap. Each tree gives two portions each morning.

upgrades.name: Forager's satchel
upgrades.description: Carry eight additional ingredients on each outing.

upgrades.name: A bigger table
upgrades.description: Restore the terrace and welcome five guests each evening.

upgrades.name: Hire Nori
upgrades.description: Nori delivers cooked dishes, leaving you free to work at the stove. Requires a restored terrace.
